body:
Queued-byte capacity alone does not bound retained files, and a cleanup queue at capacity must still be able to fence a scope. This specification-only amendment resolves four LIB-5B local simulator ambiguities before its implementation. It is stacked after LIB-5A #58. Closes #59.

## Explicit invariants

I1–I15, L1–L7 and B1–B8 stay binding. Existing LIB-5A event grammar/byte identity, original-source rights and sample-wide refusal rules remain unchanged. Public readers stay anonymous/read-only; capture, intake, photo, workers and production remain held. This adds local accounting/fence/admission definitions only, with no code, dependency, schema, credential, network, real sharing, training or publication change.

## Exactly four clarifications

1. Keep the 200,000,000 queued-byte cap; additionally count all managed retained payload copies against 200,000,000 until verified absence. Cap one metadata image at 32,000,000 bytes, current plus one replacement, and one staged payload blob at 2,000,000 per transaction. No unbounded staging/history or capacity release on mere dequeue/receipt.
2. Reserve permanent fence and generic pending-erasure state plus their active metadata budget in each of the at-most-100 scope records, separately from refusal and cleanup capacities. Saturation can close a known scope without a new alias/slot/cleanup record; no retry/dequeue reopens it.
3. Independent source/outbox and recipient 100-per-original-fake-human/UTC-day admission views charge once at first durable admission, including quarantine. Exact retries across restart/midnight are free; a distinct event repeating a measurement charges. Refusal charges nothing; later erasure refunds nothing. Cleanup ignores spent declaration allowances.
4. One private root owns all aggregate fake-authority/source/outbox/recipient state and counts both endpoint copies. Separate roots are independent simulations; no global quota or distributed-authority claim.

## Verification and prerequisites

- [x] Exact two-document patch applied and hashes checked against its frozen manifest; whitespace and full root lint/language/formatting passed.
- [x] Independent source review found zero actionable findings; exact patch/application, formatting and nine policy-preservation comparisons passed. Review receipt SHA-256 `1a647db2e57b3d16dd8eebd23bf0cb80fd9592926cce72e282fbbc55741164a3`.
- [x] Pinned gitleaks 8.21.2 two-authored-document scan reported zero findings. Scanner policy/approved exceptions unchanged.
- [ ] Exact-head CI pending at creation. No implementation test result is claimed by this documentation-only package. LIB-5B code begins only after merged LIB-5A and reviewed/green/merged v10; later tests must prove maximum/+1, crash/recovery, reserved fences, absence readback and daily admission behavior.

## Assumptions

These additional conservative simulator limits are engineering defaults under Justin's standing keep-building/source-merge authority, not measured disk-space/throughput/deletion-SLA or real retention approval. Only synthetic local preparation is authorized; every LIB-5C consent/purpose/retention/peer/credential/cleanup choice remains unresolved. SCI reference data, physical pairs, model quality and spectral privacy remain LIB-6/7 work. Earlier invariant/launch/legal/scientific sections and existing rights/saturation paragraphs are preserved apart from explicit version/status/changelog cross-references.

Codex authored the documentation; a separate agent performed exact-hash adversarial source review. Justin Hart remains human of record. No agent approving review or DCO certification; no production actions. Licences remain MIT / ODbL 1.0 / CC BY-SA 4.0.
